scripts.snapshot-check.py:
import subprocess,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
T=Path('/tmp/unisacc-v009-binary-probe');checks=[]
def snapshot(path):
 r=subprocess.run(['/bin/sh',str(T/'text.com'),'--probe-model',str(path)],capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert r.returncode==0,(path,r.returncode,r.stderr);return r.stdout
for i in range(32):
 a=snapshot(T/f'{i}.text');b=snapshot(T/f'{i}.bin');assert a==b,(i,'loaded arrays DIFFER')
 checks.append(dict(index=i,bytes=len(a),sha256=hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()))
# Mutate START only; loading succeeds, but the snapshot must differ.
b=bytearray((T/'0.bin').read_bytes());pos=9
for _ in range(4):
 while b[pos]&128:pos+=1
 pos+=1
assert b[pos]==0;b[pos]=2;(T/'mutated-start.bin').write_bytes(b)
assert snapshot(T/'0.bin')!=snapshot(T/'mutated-start.bin')
(T/'snapshot-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(checks=checks,mutated_start_detected=True,scope='all loaded scalar dimensions, strings, expanded Q arrays, H arrays/weights and declared return sets, pointer addresses excluded'),indent=2)+'\n')
print('32 loaded model snapshots identical; START mutation detected',flush=True)
scripts.host-snapshot.py:
import json,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
T=Path('/tmp/unisacc-v009-binary-probe');items=json.loads((T/'snapshot-result.json').read_text())['checks']
for x in items:
 for ext in ['text','bin']:
  r=subprocess.run([str(T/'host-san'),'--probe-model',str(T/(str(x['index'])+'.'+ext))],capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert r.returncode==0,(x['index'],ext,r.returncode,r.stderr)
  assert not r.stderr,(x['index'],ext,r.stderr)
  assert len(r.stdout)==x['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest()==x['sha256'],(x['index'],ext,'host snapshot differs')
print('ASan+UBSan: 32 text/binary model pairs match UA snapshots',flush=True)
